extracted.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
extracted.description: Great recipe for Shrimp Fried Rice.
instruction_lines: Cook rice in water with mushroom cube broth
In the meantime, cook shrimp in olive oil with 1 tbsp of teriyaki sauce and spices to taste.
Fry mixed vegetables (I used frozen mix of broccoli, red peppers, black beans, and corn) with remaining teriyaki sauce
Make scrambled eggs, then add fried vegetables, cooked rice and shrimp. Mix well. Done
